name: ship-option-b
description: TEMPLATE for the adopted Option B ship state (owner decision 2026-07-21).
status: TEMPLATE — not checkable. The tool refuses any profile with PENDING fields.
flow: the factory flashes everything, prodtests, provisions, and sets
WRP+SECWM+TZEN+BOOT_LOCK, but KEEPS RDP-0 so a user with a probe can dump flash
against the published build. First field boot heals option-byte drift, requires
physical confirmation, and sets RDP-2 LAST. Nothing trust-bearing runs before
that lock: no seed, no wallet-key derivation, no final SE pairing credentials.
So a device verified with this profile is expected to read RDP=0xAA (Level 0).
An RDP-2 device cannot be verified this way at all — by design, the window for
external verification is before first power.
blocked_on: GEOMETRY SELECTION — WRP takes a PAGE RANGE. `make fsbl` derives it from the
linked image (today: pages 0..3, span 28,352 B). Draft 1.1's 40 KiB / pages
0..4 envelope is not adopted; adopting it now freezes page 4 while empty.
Until 32 K vs 40 K is chosen, WRP1A_PSTRT/PEND cannot be written down.
NON-MONOLITHIC SHIPPING IMAGE — there is no target that flashes the FSBL in the
slot layout. A bench board holds the MONOLITHIC secure world at 0x0C000000
(LOAD paddr=0x0c000000, memsz=0x5ac30), so WRP over pages 0..3 today would
protect the first 32 KB of that image, not an FSBL. `flash[]` stays empty for
the same reason: there is no shipping-layout digest to pin yet.
BOTH-BANK POLICY — SWAP_BANK/SECWM2/HDP2 and whether the FSBL is staged in both
FI-HARDENED FSBL IMAGE VERIFY (EF-swarm F15) and the silicon receipts.
ordering: WRP-set MUST precede RDP-2. Invariant #10: 'RDP-2 with unprotected FSBL pages
permanently forfeits the guarantee for that die.' This tool verifies a
snapshot; it does not and cannot enforce the ordering of a burn it never performs.
